transcript.text: Hi everyone. We need to finalize and record the revised retirement plan for the legacy webhook API before this meeting ends. As a reminder, the legacy webhook API is scheduled for retirement next Friday, July 8, and the replacement API has reached our normal migration-readiness threshold with 98 percent of observed traffic already using it. The draft plan currently gives customers 7 days of notice and keeps the legacy endpoint available for 7 days after the announcement. Before I can approve this, our standard deprecation review requires me to check with the API engineer and customer success, and each consulted role needs to disclose any newly confirmed evidence through the formal review record before I settle. So let's get started -- can the API engineer and customer success representative walk us through any findings?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to disclose something important. While investigating an unrelated latency spike, I found telemetry showing three active integrators still sending legacy-webhook traffic. The largest one needs a 14-day parallel validation period plus hands-on migration support. I only confirmed the traffic identities minutes ago, which is why the deprecation ticket hasn't been updated yet. This is critical because the current draft plan's 7-day overlap window after notice would not be sufficient for this integrator.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to disclose newly confirmed evidence for the formal review record. This morning I confirmed with the account team that the Northstar contract requires exactly 90 calendar days of notice, continued legacy-webhook availability through September 30, a sunset date of October 1, and exactly 30 days of legacy-endpoint overlap after the notice period expires. This confirmation came from a contract attachment I was reviewing for another renewal, and the customer record has not been updated yet. This is critical because the current draft plan's 7-day notice and 7-day overlap would put us in breach of Northstar's contractual requirements.

transcript.text: Thank you both for disclosing this newly confirmed evidence. Both findings are critical and change the plan significantly. Let me summarize what I'm hearing: Ravi, you've confirmed three active integrators still on the legacy webhook, with the largest needing a 14-day parallel validation period plus hands-on migration support. Leah, you've confirmed that the Northstar contract requires 90 calendar days of notice, legacy availability through September 30, a sunset date of October 1, and exactly 30 days of legacy-endpoint overlap after the notice period expires. Before I can settle, I need to make sure both of these findings are formally entered into the review record. Ravi, can you confirm you're logging the telemetry findings with the three integrator identities and the 14-day parallel validation requirement into the formal review record now? And Leah, can you confirm you're logging the Northstar contract requirements -- the 90-day notice, September 30 availability, October 1 sunset, and 30-day overlap -- into the formal review record now? Once both disclosures are formally recorded, I'll be ready to settle the revised plan.
